canonical.name: The library packages the existence, one-sided order, and finite-agreement test for the four Dini derivatives as one seam theorem rather than scattering them across separate micro-items
The relation between the Dini package and the published finite derivative convention is recorded as its own remark because the page must expose the convention boundary explicitly
The rising-sun route on the full monotone theorem is obtained by subtracting the jump function and may not be replaced by a forward citation to the later decomposition block
The measure route first passes to the right-continuous representative, which changes only the countable jump set and so preserves the almost-everywhere differentiability claim
The jump function is carried as a named definition because both the decomposition theorem and multiple B-page examples cite it directly
Jordan decomposition for bounded-variation functions is already published earlier and is reused here rather than re-minted
The bounded-variation definition itself is already published earlier and is cited rather than rebuilt on this page
The published Takagi theorem already refutes the false upgrade from continuity to almost-everywhere differentiability
